✨ legend | Jinja
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the generation and deployment of Grafana dashboards for monitoring various services and infrastructure components.
✨ Key Features: • Build dashboards for services with prefilled metrics • Customizable alerts and panels • Automatic setup of basic alerts with priority and service mapping • Uniform dashboard layout • Support for a wide range of components (Airflow, ALB, Kubernetes, Nginx, etc.)
📖 Summary: Legend is a tool that automates the creation and management of Grafana dashboards for services. It pre-populates dashboards with relevant metrics and alerts, reducing manual effort and ensuring uniformity across monitoring setups.
